psychological_meaning: Bud represents growth, freshness, and renewal, often associated with nature and springtime. It evokes feelings of calmness, hope, and vitality, suggesting new beginnings and a connection to the environment. Bud can also symbolize potential and promise, reflecting the early stages of development and flourishing.
